---
title: "Example gallery"
subtitle: "Filter by topic, search by person, sort by date."
listing:
  id: gallery
  contents:
    - projects
    - projects/external.yml
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 3
  image-height: 200px
  image-placeholder: images/placeholder.svg
  fields: [image, title, description, author, categories, date]
  field-display-names:
    author: "Contributors"
  # Clickable topic facets, built automatically from each item's `categories`.
  categories: cloud
  sort: "date desc"
  sort-ui: [date, title, author]
  # The typeahead box searches only these fields, so typing a surname narrows
  # the gallery to that person's work.
  filter-ui: [title, description, author, categories]
  page-size: 12
  feed: false
page-layout: full
toc: false
---
